srs_secret.description: Primary secret string used for encoding SRS addresses. Overrides --secretfile for encoding if both are present.

srs_secretfile.description: Path to a file containing secrets, one per line. Used for decoding; secrets from here are also used for decoding if --secret is specified.

srs_alias.description: The alias address to which mail was sent. The domain-part is used in the generated SRS address. Required for forward mode.

srs_separator.description: String separator for the SRS address. Defaults to '='.

srs_hashlength.description: Number of base64 characters to use for the cryptographic authentication code.

srs_addresses.description: List of sender addresses to transform. Must contain at least one item if used for static batch processing.
